_influencing_factors_note: 6 Aug 2026 standard (Eduardo), replaces the exactly-3 rule: a LIST of 4 to 6 short lines (~14-18 words each, one bullet per item) that FILL the cell with the week's most relevant developments for an investment professional. quadrant_marker._note: Jun-30 reference format (17 Jul 2026 standard). The template carries the AIP Jun 30th environment: map, black Jun 30 reference point, standing note box, and the PRIOR week's single dated marker. The engine renames that marker to `label` and shifts it by (dx_emu, dy_emu) = this week's displacement vs the prior marker, both positions read against the fixed Jun 30 baseline. Right (+x) = firmer inflation expectations (lower bond-risk-factor side); up (-y) = firmer growth. NO trail: exactly one dated marker exists after every run. Legacy 3-marker transplant available via quadrant_transplant: true.

_illiquids_note: 6 Aug 2026 NEW (Eduardo); the settled same-day format. The 'Illiquid Assets' block is engine-rendered AFTER Theme 6 and BEFORE Light Scoring, on its own page: header → chart column ('Insert illiquid_1/2') beside bulleted 'What changed this week' → a 2x2 FRAMEWORK GRID (Performance | Valuations over Leverage | Dry powder) that replaces the keydev / implication / watch rows. 'What changed this week' = the window's most important PRIVATE EQUITY news from a dedicated Sonnet 5 sweep (the Illiquids beat, Run Prompt). Each grid cell is self-contained: category label, a one-line bold `read`, then `points` bullets carrying evidence + implication + watch for that category. Categories in the fixed order of `_canonical.illiquid_categories`: Performance (returns against public alternatives), Valuations (richer or cheaper, transaction-versus-mark evidence), Leverage (how much, what moves it, how measured), Dry powder (capital demand and deal appetite). RETIRED and not to return: the Buy/Hold/Sell sleeve calls (v1-v2) and the one-word Signals strip with tones (v3) — one-word weekly reads proved impossible to keep consistent; prose cells are stable. DELIBERATELY OUTSIDE THE LIGHTS SYSTEM: no traffic light, NO exec status row (still six), no entry in `light_scoring` or `light_history`. `check_illiquids` warns on any leak, on category drift, on a Buy/Hold/Sell or light-word read, and on a leftover `signals` key. Budget: ~160 words of PE news + ~65 words per grid cell (re-calibrated 13 Aug 2026 against the taller MEASURED slots — see _illiquid_slots_note, which owns the current figure), to clear the 89.5% fill ceiling.

quadrant_highlight._note: 30 Jul 2026 standard (Eduardo), REPLACES quadrant_marker. Shades the WHOLE quadrant the week sits in instead of plotting a dated dot, and removes the standing AIP note box. quadrant is one of Productivity Boost / Inflation / Deflation / Stagflation (top-left / top-right / bottom-left / bottom-right). alpha is a percent, 18-25 keeps the quadrant's own labels readable. The engine composites the wash INTO the map image rather than floating a shape over it, because the exec cell's deep negative anchor offsets are clamped by LibreOffice; baking it in is renderer-proof and scales with the map. _regime_table_note: 30 Jul 2026 NEW (Eduardo): the 'Inflation and Growth Read' block, rendered AFTER Light Scoring and BEFORE Theme Light History. Same visual grammar as Light Scoring: a colour-filled sign cell (the analogue of the Light cell) plus bulleted reasoning. sign is '+' or '-' (also accepts '=' and '+/-'); the engine colours warm for +, cool for -, grey for neutral. Use economic reasoning as well as the week's headlines, but report in bullets. This block FEEDS the page-1 quadrant: build it first, then write quadrant_rationale as its summary, and make sure quadrant_read names the same quadrant that quadrant_highlight shades. EXPANDED 30 Jul 2026 (Eduardo): the read is thorough, not a summary. Three to four evidence bullets per side per factor, each a full sentence with its numbers; the quadrant_read names the quadrant, its caveats and the quadrant's AIP asset read against the week's tape. The block page also carries the sign history strip and the quadrant residency chart; budget roughly 460 words for the table so the strip and residency fit the same page.
